title: A tag shorthand whose named handle was never declared is a syntax error
notes: A named tag handle (`!x!`) must be declared by a `%TAG` directive of the same document before it is used; there is none, so the document is invalid. The fault is in the text, the shorthand cannot be read, and not in a well-formed tag that no schema knows (`unresolved-tag`), which is why the category is `syntax`, as for `diagnostics/tag-handle-with-two-exclamation-suffix`. No position is stated: the specification does not say whether the fault is the handle or the suffix.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend reported unresolved-tag at 1:1, the pure backend syntax at 1:4.
